summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would revise definitions used to identify hospitals, local hospital networks and primary health care organisations for reporting by the National Health Performance Authority.

It would expressly authorise ministerial instruments identifying covered organisations, while public hospital definitions would require state or territory consultation or written agreement, depending on the approach.
Where no public hospital instrument applied, the ordinary meaning would be used, and local hospital networks would follow the National Health Reform Agreement definition.
changes: The two existing local hospital network definitions would be replaced with one shared definition.
Private hospital coverage would include entities determined to be private hospitals under private health insurance legislation.
An explicit power to make definition-related legislative instruments would be inserted.
Performance Authority reporting provisions would be updated to match the revised definitions.
summary.affected: Public and private hospitals, local hospital networks, primary health care organisations, health ministers and the National Health Performance Authority are affected.
